claims.statement: A requirement is created with `requirement.add "<title>|<description>"` (optionally with an external idempotency id and a deps segment) and enters `draft`; dependencies and counts are rendered back in the `[REQ ADDED]` receipt.
Dispatch is gated on dependencies being done and on a free job slot and lane; otherwise the receipt explains which of capacity, readiness or lane occupancy blocked it instead of silently no-opping.
A submitted plan proposal needs no separate acceptance step: it escalates directly into the plan gate, which is why delivery counts as the gate.

Granularity is judged before creation: changes sharing one goal, one subsystem, or one plan and one acceptance evidence set must be merged; a new requirement whose description omits the non-mergeable reason is treated as mergeable.

A newly made architectural decision takes no number and no ledger row: it is written into the decision table of the document that governs it in the same commit, and lanes editing the same decision merge in place on top of the existing paragraph.
